name: RomM
description: Self-hosted ROM library manager with scraping, metadata and multi-user support.

envVars.description: Secret key used to sign session tokens
IGDB API client ID for scraping metadata

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_NAME: romm
      DB_USER: romm
      ROMM_AUTH_SECRET_KEY: {{env.ROMM_AUTH_SECRET_KEY}}
      DB_PASSWD: {{env.DB_PASSWD}}
      IGDB_CLIENT_ID: {{env.IGDB_CLIENT_ID}}
      IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET: {{env.IGDB_CLIENT_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/library:/romm/library
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/romm/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/resources:/romm/resources
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/romm/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: romm
      MYSQL_USER: romm
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
